description: Insult, tease, or otherwise antagonise another Sim — whichever mean-family entry the target's pie menu currently offers. Prerequisite: target is within pie-menu range and exposes a mean-family entry; note the target can refuse the interaction via an incoming accept/reject dialog (respond-interaction). Effect: queues the resolved interaction; on completion the target's relationship to you drops on the friendship axis and their mood may deteriorate (TTAB-driven). Cost: in-sim minutes; queue slot; social consequences are durable — this is not a throwaway op.

args.description: Persist ID of the target Sim.

args.description: Local ObjectID of the target Sim.
